body.p:
This is a sample documentation to demonstrate my hands-on proficiency in DITA using OxygenXMLAuthor.
The version I am on is 28.1
The topics are a replica of an existing user guide of a workforce management platform I have documented. Note that all the topics will be empty.
This is exclusively created to test output transformation. Therefore, please do not expect to see demonstrations related to reusability, profiling, or any other subjects of DITA.

After a project is published by the PM, the Recruitment Director assigns the project requirement as a job to the Recruitment Team Lead. The Recruitment Lead then assigns that job requirement to a recruiter. The Recruiter is responsible for creating the job posting and publishing it to the application.
